title: Practice 14: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: I know what you're up to.
exercises.why: **замышлять → замышляешь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I'm proud of my son.
exercises.why: **гордиться → горжусь** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.q: Эбола ___ (передаваться) от человека к человеку через жидкости организма.
exercises.prompt: Ebola spreads from person to person through bodily fluids.
exercises.why: **передаваться → передаётся** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Иногда он ___ (фантазировать) о встрече с привлекательным мужчиной.
exercises.prompt: He sometimes fantasizes about meeting an attractive man.
exercises.why: **фантазировать → фантазирует** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom grows rhubarb.
exercises.why: **выращивать → выращивает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: That music gets on his nerves.
exercises.why: **нервировать → нервирует** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I regularly run in the park.
exercises.why: **бегать → бегаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: Congratulations! You have been elected as the head of the clan.
exercises.why: **поздравлять → Поздравляем** — present tense, 1st person plural: ending -ем belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Wine often goes to my head.
exercises.why: **ударять → ударяет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I get off of work at 5:30.
exercises.why: **освобождаться → освобождаюсь** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.q: Кальций, нагреваемый с помощью горелки Бунзена, ___ (окрашивать) пламя в оранжево-красный цвет.
exercises.prompt: Calcium, heated with a Bunsen burner, turns the flame orange-red.
exercises.why: **окрашивать → окрашивает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Do you recognize that girl?
exercises.why: **узнавать → узнаёшь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: В каждом аэропорту ___ (предоставляться) информация на английском.
exercises.prompt: Information is given in English at every airport.
exercises.why: **предоставляться → предоставляется** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Does nothing alarm you?
exercises.why: **настораживать → настораживает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: What kind of partnership are they proposing?
exercises.why: **предлагать → предлагают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Don't cram. Whatever you cram you will quickly forget.
exercises.why: **зубрить → зубрите** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ите belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The milk will keep for two days.
exercises.why: **храниться → хранится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Factory waste has polluted the sea.
exercises.why: **загрязнять → загрязняют** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom is sharpening his pencil.
exercises.why: **точить → точит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: "Objection!" "Sustained!"
exercises.why: **протестовать → Протестую** — present tense, 1st person singular.
